seasons.description: Gary Oldman and the Slough House misfits return in top form — sharp, hilarious, and tense.
seasons.overview: In season six, the Slow Horses are on the run as Diana Taverner embroils them all in a fatally high-stakes game of retaliation and revenge.

seasons.description: Just premiered and already dominating streaming charts — gritty, relentless crime drama at its peak.
seasons.overview: In the second season, the Harrigans struggle to show a unified front as rising rivals threaten their fractured criminal empire – and Harry Da Souza, their street-smart and formidable 'fixer', must walk a dangerous tightrope when tensions within the family intensify. As violence spills into every corner of their lives, loyalties snap, safety proves temporary, and the battle for power leaves no room for mercy.

seasons.description: Back this week with biting satire that immediately set the internet completely ablaze.
seasons.overview: Join Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny for the historic 29th season of South America.

seasons.description: HBO's high-stakes mystery has fan forums spinning wild theories week after week.
seasons.overview: Follows intergalactic cops John Stewart and Hal Jordan as they uncover a dark mystery.

seasons.description: Flawless period noir firing on all cylinders — critics are calling it an absolute masterpiece.
seasons.overview: Season 5 is based on Kutscher’s novel "The March Fallen". It's set during the last days of the German republic, running from February 1933, just after Adolf Hitler was appointed Reich Chancellor of Germany, through March 5, when a violent campaign against his political opponents secured his absolute power through elections.

seasons.description: Freshly dropped and sweeping romance fans off their feet with grand historical drama.
seasons.overview: In the second season, our lovers are separated once again as the Scottish Highlands are split in two by the 1715 Jacobite Rising, thrusting the clans into war and forcing them to choose a side in the rebellion.

seasons.description: The internet is furiously debating this divisive new spinoff — decide for yourself tonight.
seasons.overview: With Valentine's Day on the way, the gang must uncover the truth behind ghostly apparitions and a swarm of strange creatures causing chaos around town.

seasons.description: Pure adrenaline and crunching action — the ultimate crowd-pleasing weekend binge.
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

seasons.description: Taylor Sheridan's espionage thrill ride keeps heart rates pegged from the opening scene.
seasons.overview: In Season Three, hidden networks, foreign operatives, and personal betrayals collide. Joe walks the line between duty and home as unseen forces circle her world. Patterns appear where they shouldn't, names vanish, and paths rearrange. Guided by Kaitlyn and Westfield, Joe confronts enemies operating in the shadows, leaving her to reckon with a war that now reaches into every part of her life.

seasons.description: Eighteen seasons in and television's worst gang is still delivering outrageously funny chaos.
seasons.overview: Four egocentric friends who run a neighborhood Irish pub in Philadelphia try to find their way through the adult world of work and relationships. Unfortunately, their warped views and precarious judgments often lead them to trouble, creating a myriad of uncomfortable situations that usually only get worse before they get better.

seasons.description: The colossal fantasy event that everyone is still arguing about on social media.
seasons.overview: The Black and Green factions lock into an all-out, relentless struggle for the Iron Throne. As dragons and armies clash across the realm, Westeros witnesses the devastating consequences of total war.

seasons.description: Warm, hilarious, and heartwarming — the feel-good return that TV desperately needed.
seasons.overview: In season four, Ted returns to Richmond, taking on his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second division women's football team. Throughout the course of the season, Ted and the team learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would.

seasons.description: High-octane action thriller newly arrived for fans of relentless popcorn spectacle.
seasons.overview: After a daring hijack spirals into a shadowy conspiracy, fearless MI6 agent Zara and ex-protection officer Vincent must confront ruthless mercenaries and their own harrowing pasts. While a deadly virus threatens to decimate Europe, Zara and Vincent are pushed to the edge. With countless lives hanging in the balance and the clock ticking, can they outwit the brutal mercenary leader Yuri Mishkin. Or will his insidious plan for chaos succeed?

seasons.description: A quiet, emotional drama that just dropped new episodes to stream tonight.
seasons.overview: Cihan and Alya's reunion in Budapest takes an unexpected turn when Cihan insists on taking Deniz back to Mardin for his safety. As the only one who can carry on Ecmel's lineage, Deniz becomes the center of a new and dangerous family struggle, forcing Alya to fight to protect her son.

seasons.description: Classic episodic sci-fi done to absolute perfection with gorgeous visuals and boundless optimism.
seasons.overview: In the fourth season, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise—led by Captain Christopher Pike—embarks on a series of thrilling and emotional adventures across the stars. As they journey to strange new worlds, they battle inner demons and external threats, encounter colorful new characters, reunite with familiar faces and confront terrifying aliens. Through it all, they strive to embrace a bright, hopeful future.

seasons.description: Dystopian mystery at its most claustrophobic and addictive — impossible not to binge.
seasons.overview: Season three reveals an origin story set centuries earlier, while continuing the saga of a dystopian society of 10,000 people living underground under mysterious circumstances. In the present, Juliette Nichols survives her forced "cleaning" but returns with memory loss as the silo recovers from rebellion and faces a dangerous new threat. Meanwhile, in the "Before Times," journalist Helen Drew and Congressman Daniel Keene uncover a conspiracy that pulls them into a chain of events with catastrophic, irreversible consequences.

seasons.series_name: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
seasons.description: Kicking off tonight with celebrity games, musical stars, and buzzy late-night laughs.
seasons.overview: Hailing from Rockefeller Center in the heart of New York City, Jimmy has made it his mission to make sure viewers end the day with a smile. Each weeknight, he hosts A-list guests, from movie stars to athletes, comedians, public figures and everyone in between. He also delivers a signature nightly monologue, performs in topical comedy sketches, plays fan-favorite games, and presents recurring segments like Thank You Notes. Today's popular musical guests also stop by to perform alongside house band The Roots.

seasons.description: Sleek, dark, and provocative 1980s crime thriller that oozes cinematic atmosphere.
seasons.overview: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

seasons.description: Nicolas Cage shines in this stylish, shadowy pulp comic adaptation.
seasons.overview: Private investigator Ben Reilly is hired on a couple of straightforward cases... until mobsters, monsters, and a mysterious femme fatale spin a web that brings him face to face with his former life as New York's only superhero: The Spider.

seasons.description: Mind-bending multiverse madness packed with the series' signature rapid-fire comedic brilliance.
seasons.overview: Season 9 is all certified bangers. No AI slop! Just Grade A organic slop, made by real humans with real human traits like back hair and cysts. Please watch, or we'll have neglected our families for nothing.

seasons.description: Gripping, dark procedural comfort food that longtime fans can reliably savor tonight.
seasons.overview: As the BAU investigates a string of chilling new cases, Elias Voit embarks on a path to atone for his past. His newfound infamy inadvertently awakens their most formidable nemesis yet, The Fan. Precise, calculating, and relentlessly dangerous, this UnSub pushes the BAU to the brink and back under the shadow of Elias Voit. But how far will The Fan go to prove his superiority over his idol?

seasons.description: Gritty post-apocalyptic tension in the ruins of Manhattan keeps horror fans hooked.
seasons.overview: In season three, Maggie and Negan finally put aside their differences to build the first thriving community in Manhattan since the apocalypse, but when chaos in the city begins to arise, they are forced to question: have they learned from their old wounds or will their dark past spell doom for the entire city?

seasons.series_name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
seasons.description: Charming, offbeat sci-fi comedy filled with weird alien antics and laugh-out-loud moments.
seasons.overview: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon and Leonard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon. Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke.

seasons.description: Classic animated comfort TV delivering nostalgic laughs and clever future gags.
seasons.overview: Brace yourselves... The future is about to get a whole lot stranger! It's a non-stop onslaught of swaggering space pirates, lab-grown meats, sexy scams... plus the shocking return of Dr. Zoidberg's lost love! You didn't see that coming, prior to being told about it just now!

seasons.description: A stylish, bubbly prequel comedy that brings delightful early-2000s charm back to screens.
seasons.overview: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

seasons.description: Twisty, bingeable Harlan Coben mystery that keeps you guessing until the final frame.
seasons.overview: An innocent father serves a life sentence for the murder of his own son. When he receives evidence that his son my still be alive, he is determined to break out of prison to discover the truth.

seasons.description: Chilling psychological cat-and-mouse game anchored by magnetic prestige performances.
seasons.overview: A storm is coming for two happily married attorneys when a notorious killer from their past gets out of prison.

seasons.description: Wholesome frontier drama reimagined for an evening of nostalgic family viewing.
seasons.overview:
Based upon the best selling "Little House" series of books by Laura Ingalls Wilder.

The show follows the lives of a simple farming family, the Ingalls, who settle into a quaint little house near the small town of Walnut Grove during the late 1800s. The majority of the shows were narrated by Laura and the series follows her from when she and her family arrive in Walnut Grove until her adulthood with Almanzo Wilder, with whom she starts a family of her own.

seasons.series_name: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
seasons.description: Dry, neurotic comedy giving an irreverent, deeply cynical spin on American history.
Under-the-radar crime drama that offers solid suspense for late-night mystery seekers.
seasons.overview: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.
